Enter the approval date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
Enter the realization date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
Enter the finishing date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
Attach the link to the EP’s contract.
Attach link to EP's invoice of Payment and Payment Proof
Attach relevant documents (visa, PPL, etc.). If a visa is not required, attach a communication thread with the Host Entity explaining the situation.
Attach proof of ES delivery to the EP (PPT and MoM).
Attach the link to your national ES tracker. Ensure it is fully completed and includes all required document links.
Attach the communication thread with the EP (exported chat is acceptable).
Attach the latest risk management document for the product using ECB tools.

Enter the payment date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
